summary: Tested the 4 Phase-3 features with 6 Chromium contexts against localhost:3000, in isolated rooms. Four contexts had Date.now skewed: +90s, -120s, +45s and -60s. The new script e2e/t1-phase3-iter3.cjs ran 2 full times and 2 power-only times. Its last full run passed 21/21 checks. In the first full run, 4 checks failed because of test-script problems, not app problems: a self-position read, and pressing F instead of E at the power panel. Every feature works. Shared clock: the 12s starting grace, leak banner, power-cut banner (14s, then 8s), meeting timer ('Discussion: 40s') and emergency cooldown ('Cooldown: 59s') all matched across every skewed and unskewed browser. Leak clue: it switches to a later Government visitor (MP2) on all 6 clients and is gone in the next body-report meeting. Map overlay: M, the button, the close button and a backdrop click all work. Sampled pixels show a green open marker and a red OFFLINE marker. Ghosts: killed and voted-out ghosts drift through furniture and walls. Each ghost sees the other in both directions. Living clients' stores stay at the death spot, and living canvases draw no ghosts. Ghosts are rejected from task, emergency, report, chat and vote, and their UI buttons are disabled.

ui_bugs.issue: WASD still moves the player while the full-screen map overlay is open: pressing S for 300ms moved the player. The player walks blind behind the modal. Consider pausing movement while the map is open, or say that it keeps going.

issues: The 'Fellow agents' block plus the 12-row cover task list in .hud--tasks runs under the bottom-left controls legend. 'Sign the Register', 'File the Motion', 'Approve the Bill' and 'Fix Hall Lighting' are hidden behind it. The Government list is shorter and fits.

The red eliminated-banner (3 lines) at the top of the canvas covers the name labels of players standing on spawn row 3 ('Speaker', 'MP1', etc.). Consider a slimmer one-line banner, or put it at the bottom.

action_items: LOW: stop or limit local movement while the map overlay is open
LOW: fix the Deep State HUD task list overlapping the controls legend at 1280x800, e.g. max-height with scroll, or collapse it by default
LOW: make the ghost banner less tall so it doesn't cover players' name labels
critical_code_review_comments: Match.sabotageAction gives the starting clue to the living player nearest the station at leak time, not to the leaker. A Government MP standing closer to the station than the agent (both within 48px) is blamed immediately. The brief says 'initially the leaker'. If that is intended, set playerId to the actor (p.id).
trackLeakSighting only runs on accepted moves. A player standing still in range is never re-recorded, so the clue means 'the last to step in range', not 'the last seen'. Fine, but document it.

lobbyHandlers GAME_STARTED uses match.view(), whose default ghostView is true. This is harmless at start because nobody is dead, but the default is the unmasked view. Consider defaulting ghostView to false so a future reuse cannot leak ghost positions.
The clock offset is sampled only on connect and game start (4 samples). That is fine for skew, but there is no periodic resync to correct drift in long sessions or after a laptop sleeps.
The local player's own position is not written to store.game.match.players. The canvas uses local refs. That is fine, but tests must read a ghost's position from another ghost's store.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend e2e only; server behaviour checked through socket acks)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (21/21 feature checks in the last full run, plus 2/2 power-banner checks)

seed_data_creation: None. Only in-memory rooms, created for each run and dropped when the browsers close.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: node e2e/t1-phase3-iter3.cjs <base> (about 150s). It joins 6 contexts with Date.now skews [0,+90,-120,0,+45,-60]s. It checks the grace cooldown and map overlay (pixel sampling of the overlay canvas at station coordinates). A Deep agent leaks ls-motion from tile (15,4), walks to (18,4), and a Government visitor walks to (15,3). An emergency meeting follows, where the clue should name the visitor. Everyone skips, then the emergency cooldown is checked. D1 kills a Government MP while D2 cuts power at (15,22) with KeyE (F is leak only), then the power banner is checked. Next comes a body-report meeting: no clue expected, ghost vote rejected, Government votes out D2. Last, the D2 ghost drifts down 240px through furniture and walls, and the first ghost sees it while living clients don't. Mode 'power' (argv[3]) runs only the power-banner check. Note: the local player's position is not mirrored in store.game.match.players.
